spec.name: points-n6-utg5-hj7-co9-btn11-sb13-bb15
spec.note: 60 bb on the table: 12,000 chips, big blind 200 chips; stacks in chips UTG 1000, HJ 1400, CO 1800, BTN 2200, SB 2600, BB 3000

ev_definition: expected league points after the hand (Malmuth-Harville on the stacks after the hand)
class_order: 13x13 grid, index 13*i+j with R='AKQJT98765432': i==j pair R[i]R[i], i<j suited R[i]R[j]s, i>j offsuit R[j]R[i]o (same as data/ranges.json and web/js/poker.js)

accuracy.equity_method: Monte Carlo over complete deals (board and all hole cards from one deck), every possible hero hand enumerated per deal; all card removal (blockers, folded hands, board) and multi-way side pots exact per deal; error = sampling error, reported as standard errors
